themes.title: Consumption revival & FMCG premiumization
themes.need: Rural recovery, GST 2.0 and premiumization still frame the theme, but Q1FY27 rewarded portfolio SHAPE over volume. TATACONSUM's growth businesses hit INR 1,300cr (+47%) and are now 36% of India - larger than either salt (>INR 1,000cr) or tea & coffee (INR 1,200cr), with Sampann +58%, RTD +41% and Capital Foods INR 232cr (+40%) - while India tea revenue fell 4% on +2% volume as lower tea costs were deliberately passed back (tea inflation is now running 7-10% with most buying still ahead, so that inverts next year). PGHH shows the margin route: FY26 sales roughly flat at ~INR 4,300cr but PAT +19% to ~INR 850cr and ~100bps of structural margin from INR 86cr of productivity savings, absorbing crude and resin each up 30-50% with no stock-outs. The cautionary tale is licensed brands - JYOTHYLAB lost the Pril and Fa licences when Henkel did not renew (all manufacturing and selling stopped 1-June; Pril was ~7-8% of revenue, ~INR 225-240cr) and has filed SIAC arbitration. MARICO/DABUR/GODREJCP/COLPAL/EMAMILTD ride distribution + premium mix; VBL on beverage route-to-market; BIKAJI/GOPAL/BECTORFOOD on branded snacks; ORKLAINDIA took a 4% blended price increase in Q4 plus premium mix to a 16.9% EBITDA margin.
themes.driver: GST 2.0 demand pull-through; rural volume recovery; festive/wedding restocking; commodity pass-back timing; JYOTHYLAB's ~7-8% revenue hole and the SIAC arbitration.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- House-of-brands model: Mamaearth as the anchor brand plus "Younger Brands" defined in the deck as The Derma Co., Aqualogica, Dr. Sheth's, Bblunt, Staze and BTM Ventures Limited (Reginald Men); the deck says Younger Brands "continued to grow at 40%+".
- The deck frames a recurring "Crystal-Gazing the Future of I-Beauty" thesis — categories previously explored were Face Cleansers, Face Serums, Moisturizers, Hair Care, Colour Cosmetics, Oral Beauty, Men's Skin Care and Nutraceuticals; this edition's theme is "THE SCENT ECONOMY" (Fragrance).
- Fragrance opportunity as framed by the deck: "~3% fragrance share of India's BPC market, vs ~11% globally"; "INR 7,000 Cr+ India's perfume market in 2026, growing at a 15% CAGR"; penetration headroom of ~6% of Indians using fragrance vs ~37% in the US; ~28% of fragrance value now e-commerce, up from ~6.5% in 2015. The deck adds "There is a large unorganised market beyond the above market size, which is moving to organized".
- Consumer-pull evidence rather than pure distribution push: indexed brand searches for Mamaearth 100 (Q1FY26) → 136 (Q1FY27) and for The Derma Co 100 → 134 ("Brand searches grew 34% YoY"), both "Based on Google Adwords"; "Share Amongst Handlers*" is described as signifying "increasing consumer pull".
- Brand purpose line: "Beauty inspired by Goodness".

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Acquisition] BTM Ventures Limited (Reginald Men) is at "INR 150 Cr+ Annual Revenue Run Rate" based on Q1FY27 Net Sales Value; it is excluded from the UVG definition but included in Consolidated Revenue from Operations.
- [Accounting change] A "Change in settlement by Flipkart group" altered revenue recognition for marketplace sellers like Honasa: logistics & fulfilment cost is now adjusted in (netted off against) revenue. The deck's illustration shows Revenue 100 → 68, COGS 30 → 30, Gross Margin 70 → 38, Logistics & Fulfilment cost 32 → 0, with "Contribution margin" unchanged at 38 (32% both before and after). Impact is stated as "~INR 29 Cr revenue recognition impact in the topline with no effect on absolute profitability".
- [Reporting basis] Because of the above, the deck presents Honasa Revenue from Operations and "All Margin %" on a Like-for-Like (LFL) basis for Q1FY27; the deck shows both bases side by side (LFL Q1FY26 572, Q1FY26 595, Reported Q1FY27 756, LFL Q1FY27 785), so headline growth and margin figures in the highlights are LFL, not reported.
- [Deck scope] The deck is the covering letter plus investor presentation filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, signed by Gaurav Pandit, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer; CIN L74999DL2016PLC306016, NSE symbol HONASA / BSE scrip code 544014.
